failure_taxonomy.success: coverage: strict CE success; capture: target captured; mixed: safe completion
failure_taxonomy.boundary: boundary flag is true and collision is false
failure_taxonomy.strict_CE_not_reached: pure coverage failed strict CE without collision/boundary
failure_taxonomy.capture_not_achieved_or_censored: pure capture ended without target capture
failure_taxonomy.post_capture_CE_or_safe_completion_failu: mixed rollout captured but did not safely complete CE mission

protocol.stage_comparison: Existing registry formal reports for selected Stage1/Stage2/Stage3 checkpoints, 20 episodes per scene; Stage3 values in the separate fresh Stage3/generalization section are from the new 2026-10-06 batch.
protocol.generalization: Map remains 120x120; obstacles fixed at 3; enemies remain 3 for capture/mixed and 0 for pure coverage. Pursuer counts are 12/18/24. Large/Medium run through the evaluator normalized sensing resolver.
protocol.sensing_rule: Runtime resolver formula R=k*sqrt(A_eff/N), k=0.8715, floor=20; A_eff and R are read from each episode resolver payload.
protocol.coverage_initialization: Native Small preserves Stage3 spawn_cluster_radius from config (13.0); Medium/Large coverage spawn radius is resolved at runtime with the same normalized radius rule.
protocol.training_changes: None: no training, reward, model, or training-contract changes.
